name: Dev-via-spec Builder → QA-Reviewer Handoff
description: When the dev-via-spec-builder terminates with builder_decide(action=tests_passing|tests_failing) AND the evidence preprocessor has stamped evidence.summary_ready=true, this rule spawns the dev-via-spec-qa-reviewer (R3.7.2.j′ persona) to grade the build deliverable against the architect's checks. R3.7.2.k′-bis of ADR-036. needs_clarification from the builder is intentionally NOT a trigger here — that's a chain-coverage gap the operator (today) or R3.5 coordinator-as-meta-reviewer (future) handles, not a build to review.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-qa-reviewer
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-spec-builder has terminated with builder_decide. Builder loop id: $entity.instance. Verdict: $entity.triple.coordinator.next_action. Reason: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision_reason.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to inspect the builder's structured terminal (action, tests_run, tests_passed, tests_failed, artifact_summary OR failure_summary + retry_hint).

Evidence summary (gate-rendered from architect's checks[]):

```
$entity.triple.evidence.summary
```

Iteration 2 — emit decide(action=accept|reject|needs_clarification, reason=<concrete>, blocking_question=<if needs_clarification>) per your 10-evaluation-contract.md three-rule grading.

metadata.pattern: post-build review spawn — fires on the builder's tests_passing/tests_failing terminal AND evidence.summary_ready=true (two-AND condition). The evidence.summary_ready predicate is a synthetic synchronisation point that ensures the preprocessor has finished running checks before the qa-reviewer is spawned. The false→true transition fires on_enter exactly once regardless of which triple (coordinator.next_action or evidence.summary_ready) writes last — per stateful_rule_test.go verification at beta.45.
metadata.evidence_summary_plumbing: k′-bis (slice 4) shipped — preprocessor at cmd/semteams/evidence/preprocessor.go subscribes to agent.complete.> and stamps evidence.summary + evidence.summary_ready triples at builder-loop completion time. Triple-substitution syntax ($entity.triple.evidence.summary) inlines the rendered output into the qa-reviewer spawn prompt.
metadata.next_action_filter: tests_passing OR tests_failing only. needs_clarification from the builder is the persona-canonical boot-failure terminal (10-bash-iteration-contract.md Step 0); routing it back through qa-reviewer would mis-categorise wiring failure as build failure. R3.5 coordinator-as-meta-reviewer (ADR-031 §addendum 2026-05-02) is the right home for needs_clarification routing once it ships.
